note: Each SmartBite food mapped by hand to one BLS Average Price Data series (area 0000, U.S. city average), fetched from the BLS public API v1, or, for fruits and vegetables BLS does not price, to one item of the USDA ERS Fruit and Vegetable Prices (2023 annual average retail price per lb, moved to the BLS period with the matching CPI index in cpi). match: exact, close (same food, mixed with its subtypes), broad (a different or wider product, no price), none (nothing to match; no price). Only exact and close get an estimated price. Size: grams (453.6 per lb, or the stated ounces), litres (3.785 per gallon, density from packs.json) or eggs (per dozen). BLS series with no 2025 or 2026 data: apples, broccoli, peppers, onions, carrots, cucumbers, canned tuna, peanut butter, scallions, precooked rice.
